race.comment: GEOSTORM (1) led and won here two back before being run down last start over further, beaten a head in a close finish. He rises in weight again, but Loy sticks and a better draw this time can help. Can work across and go one better. MELODIA PERFECTA (5) disappointed last start after a good win from the front at Queanbeyan two back. Back in trip is a good bonus off a 61-day freshen and Ellison's claim comes in handy. Can sit close to the speed and be prominent from the outset. SIR LUNCHALOTS (2) is third-up now and will find this much easier. Blinkers go back on and he won't be far away. ON POINT PIXIE (4) is next best.
